company.name: SC EURO GAMES TECHNOLOGY ROMANIA SRL

details.idealCandidate:
• The candidate we are looking for should be professional and a person who understands the meaning of confidentiality;
  • Mandatory A, B, BE, D category driving license
  • Exceptional driving skills;
  • + 2 years of previous experience;
  • Watchful and Safety conscious: He should drive with consideration at all times and he ought to likewise consider the wellbeing of other road users;
  • Excellent conversational skills in English.
details.jobDescription:
• Welcomes guests at the front entrance of the company in a timely and pleasant manner;
  • Ensures organized and efficient valet operations and directs traffic as needed;
  • Acts as a resource to guests and team members by maintaining thorough knowledge of the facility, inside and out;
  • Ensures valet areas are safe, clean, and attractive. Perform light cleaning duties if needed and daily maintenance of the vehicles;
  • Safely and timely drive the managers to work and back, to venues, events, and all other locations indicated;
  • Ensures that the car is clean at all times by washing both its inside and outside parts;
  • Carry out routine inspections on the car to ensure that it is always in good condition;
  • Identify electrical and mechanical problems that may hinder the smooth working of the car and carry out minor repairs and maintenance where necessary;
  • Find out possible electrical or mechanical defects in the car and report to the employer for it to be taken to a technician for repair;
  • Considers different routes, and checks climate and traffic reports to decide the best time to travel and the best route to take;
  • Safely keep receipts for vehicle repairs and maintenance and other records and reports concerning the employer’s car(s);
  • Keep a travel log to record locations traveled to, travel time, and work hours;
  • Carry out other assignments that the employer may give.
details.companyDescription:
About Euro Games Technology (EGT)
Euro Games Technology (EGT) is a globally recognized company in the gaming and casino equipment industry, known as one of the leading players in the international gambling sector. With operations in over 100 countries and a team of more than 3,800 professionals, EGT continues to strengthen its global presence through innovation and excellence.
EGT Romania, established in 2005, is among the fastest-growing companies in the Romanian gambling market. As a top distributor of slot machines, high-end gaming platforms and casino games, EGT Romania is distinguished by its unwavering focus on quality, performance and customer satisfaction.
By joining our team, you’ll become part of a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values professionalism, integrity and innovation.

Data Protection Notice:
By submitting your application for this role, you consent to the processing of your personal data contained in your résumé. In accordance with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to be informed, the right to access and update your personal data, the right to object to its processing, and the right to request its deletion from our records at any time.
